translations.web: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way! Remove the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.”
translations.bsb: And it will be said, “Build it up, build it up, prepare the way, take every obstacle out of the way of My people.”
translations.kjv: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
translations.asv: And he will say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.
